240-574-5470-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-5470-8201.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5078-5434-6918-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-801-3249-4474.easyPrerequisites:
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
728-801-3249-4474.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1580-2060-6701-8095.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1580-2060-6701-8095.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a stun counter on it

514-654-3899-5944.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 2.

3899-5702-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

104-3490-4050-7818.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4050-7818.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2178-5231-7690-7797--165.description:
Activate Agent Phil Coulson by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Hero you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Wall.
When the Wall dies, Agent Phil Coulson triggers, untapping Agent Phil Coulson.
Repeat.

1591-1778-3661-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1591-1778-3661-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1987-4668-5913.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-4668-5913.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1987-4668-5913.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Pinnacle Monk.
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4668-5913.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

955-1409-3099-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

570-876-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Faeburrow Elder.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Faeburrow Elder.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Faeburrow Elder.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Faeburrow Elder.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Faeburrow Elder.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Faeburrow Elder from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-2265-3099-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Hardened Scales and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2167-6557-7380-7384.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Underground Mortuary, adding {G}.
Activate Floral Evoker by paying {G} and discarding Veilborn Ghoul, returning Underground Mortuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Underground Mortuary enters, it, Floral Evoker and Veilborn Ghoul trigger.
Resolve the Underground Mortuary trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Floral Evoker trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Veilborn Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3756-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3756-4231-6753.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3094-4659-5223-5390-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
3094-4659-5223-5390-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

1912-4131-7290.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1912-4131-7290.description:
Cause Basalt Monolith to become a creature using Does Machines.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

64-109-232-1235.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Warden of the Eye.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Warden of the Eye with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Warden of the Eye tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1550-4251-6968.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-4251-6968.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3293-5226-5478-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5226-5478-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5226-5478-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1978-2060-5296-6842.description:
Activate Iron Spider by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature and/or Vehicle you control.
Activate Workhorse and Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from each of them, adding {1}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Iron Spider.
Repeat.
1978-2060-5296-6842.notes: This combo doesn't put infinite counters on Crystalline Crawler or Workhorse.

325-5437-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-5437-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
325-5437-5796-6282.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat.

3951-4875-5147-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-4875-5147-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

803-1429-3698-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-3698-5402.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

222-527-3480-3967.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-3480-3967.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2452-4484-5686.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
2452-4484-5686.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ebondeath
Repeat.

2178-5256-5470.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
2178-5256-5470.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

4636-4659-5391-5392.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Era of Innovation trigger.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Robot, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Era of Innovation trigger, causing you to pay {1} to get {E}{E}.
Resolve the Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {E}, you may forego sacrificing the Robots.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

802-1980-2493-3652-5326.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{B}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
802-1980-2493-3652-5326.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{B}.
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Archaeomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Snap to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting The Master.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Snap, targeting Ornithopter.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Ornithopter to your hand from the battlefield, and untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{B}.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning The Master to your hand from the battlefield, and untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

1012-4487-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Marauder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

565-2450-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
565-2450-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Palinchron.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
The Palinchron token enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you can target any permanents you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

800-1656-3181.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
800-1656-3181.description:
Activate Krosan Restorer threshold ability with Necrotic Ooze to untap up to three lands.
Activate Knacksaw Qlique with Nectrotic Ooze to untap it, and have target opponent remove the top card of their library from the game.
Until end of turn you may play that card.
Continue looping as long as needed, generating infinite mana among lands you control.
From here, you could either cast every card from your opponent' libraries, or Move to your next turn and win from them decking out.
